title: ShieldRequest
description: Incoming request from an AI Agent to SLAShield402 before making a payment

payment_id.description: Unique identifier for this payment request

target_api.description: Target API endpoint URL to be queried

agent_wallet.description: Algorand address of the AI agent requesting the payment

provider_address.description: Algorand address of the API service provider

offer_price.description: Price offered for the API call (e.g. '0.02 USDC' or 0.02)

agent_budget_left.description: Remaining budget of the agent (e.g. '1.00 USDC' or 1.00)
